notes.title: RoadOut Hits the Gas with New Trailer and Updated Demo!
notes.content:
[p]Hey Roadsters![/p][p][/p][p]We have some great news! We have just revealed a new demo and trailer for you to feast your wheels on![/p][p][/p][p]The new "Into the Dead Zone" trailer highlights [i]RoadOut[/i]’s mix of [b]twin stick action[/b], [b]on-wheels exploration[/b] and [b]rock n’ roll style racing[/b] (yes, like the SNES game).[/p][p]
[/p][previewyoutube="4_C2liy6u8Y;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][p]The updated demo of [i]RoadOut[/i] on [b]Steam[/b] (and [b]Xbox!)[/b] lets you try out a sizable chunk of Claire’s struggle against vile gang factions in The Dead Zone, puzzle-filled dungeon exploration and rubber-burning gameplay! Give it a shot and wishlist the game to stay up to date![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839200/RoadOut_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]RoadOut is scheduled to release on Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S in Q1 2026! Mark your calendars![/p][p][/p][p]We look forward to hearing your feedback! If you like the demo, please considering giving it a review on the demo page! It helps us a lot![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for all the support!
[/p]

notes.title: The Engine is Back On!
notes.content:
[p]🚗🔥 The engine is back on![/p][p]It’s been a while since our last announcement and we are hitting the gas again with some big news. [b]RoadOut will be at BIG Festival 2025![/b] 🎉[/p][p]We have been carefully listening to your feedback and the demo already received some updates based on what the community shared with us.
There is also a [b]new demo page on Steam[/b]. If you get the chance, please give it a try and leave your feedback there, it really helps us a lot 🙌[/p][p]This is just the beginning. The engine is heating up and plenty of exciting news are coming in the next few weeks. Stay tuned because the road ahead is full of action 🏁[/p]

notes.title: 🚀 RoadOut in the Made in Brazil Sale!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621041/c8da74ab02f20398ab92191feb3e1d93188c63aa.png[/img]

🚀 RoadOut in the Made in Brazil Sale! 🇧🇷🔥
Hey everyone! We’ve got some exciting news: On February 28th, RoadOut will be part of the Made in Brazil Sale on Steam! 🎮✨

This is the perfect chance to jump into our high-speed, action-packed adventure in a post-apocalyptic world. 🌍🏎️

And that’s not all! We’re working on some exciting updates that we’ll be revealing soon. 👀 Stay tuned!

📅 Mark your calendars: February 28th!

Support Brazilian games and join us on this journey! 🚗⚡

notes.title: We launched a Kickstarter
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621041/a49dc13e97dd0adf40459d778e3433821cfd1e81.png[/img]

Hello people,
After some time in development, we have good news for you:

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rastrolabs/roadout]WE LAUNCHED A KICKSTARTER!!!![/url]

to take the project to the next level we are launching a Kickstarter, we think that putting the project on the platform will add a lot of benefit to the game, and we can do things our way.

And that's not all, we also released a new build with more gameplay features such as:
[olist]
[*] New quests
[*] New Enemies
[*] New Music
[*] Trading Mechanics
[*] Racing mechanics
[/olist]
And much more, it's already released to test in so play and leave your feedback.

Thanks
